Xiao Hei Prototype Related Rumors.Abandonment Rumor (\"A kitten raised fro: Xiao Hei's prototype was a stray cat born in early May 2009 in the Biyantian Community (Qileyuan neighborhood), where MTJJ's former company was located. MTJJ and his roommate Wang Wang watched the cat grow up together. On December 10, 2009, the 7-month-old Xiao Hei was brought home after approaching humans outdoors. However, Xiao Hei was extremely afraid of people indoors, hiding under the bed, then fleeing to the storage room, staying in darkness, and only moving at night. It took a month to take the first photo. Despite being neutered, Xiao Hei longed for the outdoors, frequently scratching doors, howling, damaging window screens to escape, and defecating in neighbors' homes, leading to being beaten until his eye bled and pupil changed color. MTJJ consulted pet doctors and stray cat rescue organizations, who advised that such extremely fearful cats are difficult to adopt and the common practice is TNR (Trap-Neuter-Return). Initially unwilling to release Xiao Hei, MTJJ tried confining him to the balcony, but Xiao Hei remained restless and attempted to escape from the balcony roof. Realizing confinement was not protection but imprisonment, Xiao Hei was returned to Qileyuan (his birthplace) on July 2, 2010, not "thrown into the wild". The Legend of Luo Xiaohei premiered on March 17, 2011, created by MTJJ to commemorate the regret of not being able to become family with Xiao Hei, not "cashing in on the cat's story". For the first decade, the animation was funded by MTJJ taking freelance work and selling merchandise, only becoming profitable in 2020. MTJJ has never hidden this story, instead mentioning it actively, and continues to participate in stray cat rescue: personally rescuing and rehoming 7 cats, including Robin (found in September 2009) and Xiao Jian (Xiao Hei and Robin's kitten, kept due to fearfulness); company colleagues have adopted over 50 stray cats collectively, and the team funds stray cat sterilization and adoption events, practicing "adopt don't shop". Between 2020-2025, over 200 stray cats were sterilized with team funding.
Xiao Hei Prototype Related Rumors.Second Abandonment Rumor (\"After Xiao H: This rumor is completely false. First, Xiao Hei was released on July 2, 2010, while MTJJ started learning to drive on March 22, 2011 (documented in his Weibo posts), making it impossible to drive Xiao Hei away. Second, the description of "Xiao Hei running back home" actually refers to a comic interaction on November 5, 2011, where the "Luo Xiaohei CAT" account shared prototype designs for merchandise dolls. The "Xiao Hei" in the image was a doll, not the real cat. 500 dolls were produced, mostly sold by January 2012, with remaining ones given to fans, not discarded. Finally, Yanjiao is where MTJJ and his roommates moved in July 2011 (from Tiantongyuan to Yanjiao), not "throwing the cat from Tiantongyuan to Yanjiao". No "second abandonment" occurred. Former colleagues continued to see and feed Xiao Hei in Qileyuan after release, and his life there remained stable.
Xiao Hei Prototype Related Rumors.True Experiences and Personality of Xiao: Xiao Hei's prototype consists of three cats (Robin, Xiao Jian, Xiao Hei), with "Luo Xiaohei" combining characters from each name. Robin, found in September 2009, is affectionate and accepts petting. Xiao Jian, Xiao Hei and Robin's kitten, was kept due to fearfulness and still lives with MTJJ's family. Xiao Hei, brought home at 7 months, was extremely afraid of humans but friendly to other cats, accepting only brushing, and ran away without looking back when released. Former colleagues saw and fed Xiao Hei until around 2015. Lacking experience, MTJJ didn't know about TNR (Trap-Neuter-Return). Releasing Xiao Hei aimed for his freedom and safety, not intentional abandonment. This incident left them feeling guilty and regretful, prompting them to learn and practice TNR later.
